About_Description: CrapFixer is a lightweight Windows tweaking companion to FluentCleaner. It uses the Wintweak2.ini and Winappx.ini databases.
About_SettingsBackup: Export or import your settings as JSON. Place settings.json next to the app for portable mode.
About_Imported: Settings imported. Restart CrapFixer to apply everything.
Tweak_Description_Disable File Explorer: Disables sync provider notifications (OneDrive ads) in the File Explorer status bar.
Tweak_Description_Disable Finish Setup A: Stops Windows from showing setup prompts and ads after user profile creation.
Tweak_Description_Disable Lock Screen Ad: Removes Windows Spotlight ads and overlay from the lock screen.
Tweak_Description_Disable Personalized A: Turns off the advertising ID used for personalized ads across apps.
Tweak_Description_Disable Settings App A: Removes Microsoft account, Office, and app suggestions from the Settings app.
Tweak_Description_Disable Start Menu Ads: Removes app recommendations and ads from the Start menu (Windows 11).
Tweak_Description_Disable Tailored Exper: Prevents Microsoft from using diagnostic data to show personalized tips, ads, and recommendations.
Tweak_Description_Disable Tips and Sugge: Turns off Windows tips and suggestions that appear on the lock screen and in notifications.
Tweak_Description_Disable Welcome Experi: Hides the "What's new" and welcome experience after Windows updates.
Tweak_Description_Disable Click To Do: Disables the Click To Do AI overlay feature (Windows 11 Recall-related feature).
Tweak_Description_Disable Copilot on Tas: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar via policy.
Tweak_Description_Disable Recall: Prevents Windows Recall (AI screenshot indexer) from being enabled on Copilot+ PCs.
Tweak_Description_Disable Search Box Sug: Turns off web-based suggestions in the Start menu search box for privacy.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Browser S: Prevents Microsoft Edge from prompting users to sign in with a Microsoft account.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Default T: Hides default top site shortcuts (e.g. MSN, Office) on the Edge new tab page.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Default B: Stops Edge from prompting users to set it as the default browser.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Collectio: Disables the Collections feature in Microsoft Edge.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Shopping: Turns off the price comparison and shopping assistant sidebar in Edge.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge First Run: Skips the welcome/first-run page that appears after a fresh Edge install or update.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Gamer Mod: Disables the Gamer Mode feature in Microsoft Edge.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Hubs Side: Removes the Hubs sidebar (Discover, Tools, etc.) from Microsoft Edge.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Import on: Prevents Edge from showing the import data dialog on each launch.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge Startup B: Turns off Edge Startup Boost which keeps Edge running in the background after closing.
Tweak_Name_Disable Edge New Tab Quick Li: Disable Edge New Tab Quick Links
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge New Tab Q: Hides quick link shortcuts on the Edge new tab page.
Tweak_Description_Disable Edge User Feed: Prevents users from submitting feedback to Microsoft from Edge.
Tweak_Description_Disable Game DVR: Disables Xbox Game DVR background recording which can reduce gaming performance and CPU usage.
Tweak_Description_Disable Power Throttli: Disables Power Throttling so the CPU runs at full speed for all processes, improving performance.
Tweak_Description_Optimize Visual Effect: Sets Windows visual effects to "Adjust for best performance" mode, reducing animations.
Tweak_Description_Disable Activity Histo: Stops Windows from recording activities (apps opened, files used) for the Timeline feature.
Tweak_Description_Disable App Launch Tra: Prevents Windows from tracking which apps you launch for personalized Start menu suggestions.
Tweak_Description_Reduce Diagnostic Data: Limits Windows diagnostic and telemetry data sent to Microsoft to the minimum allowed level.
Tweak_Description_Disable Location Track: Disables the Windows location service for all apps on the device.
Tweak_Description_Disable Lock Screen Sl: Disables the lock screen slideshow that can use personal photos.
Tweak_Description_Disable Narrator Onlin: Prevents Windows Narrator from sending data to Microsoft online services.
Tweak_Description_Disable Online Speech: Turns off cloud-based speech recognition and input personalization.
Tweak_Description_Disable Silent App Ins: Stops Windows from silently installing suggested apps in the background.
Tweak_Description_Disable Windows Spotli: Turns off Windows Spotlight which shows Microsoft-curated images and tips on the lock screen.
Tweak_Description_Show BSOD Details: Displays technical details (stop code, parameters) on Blue Screen of Death instead of the smiley face.
Tweak_Description_Disable Hibernation: Disables Windows hibernation to free up disk space (saves a file equal to your RAM size).
Tweak_Description_Reduce Menu Show Delay: Sets the submenu hover delay to 10ms. Windows default is 400ms. If your current value is already below 10ms, applying this will increase it.
Tweak_Description_Disable Network Thrott: Removes the Windows multimedia networking throttle that can limit network throughput for background tasks.
Tweak_Description_Speed Up Shutdown: Reduces the time Windows waits for services to stop on shutdown from 5000ms to 1000ms.
Tweak_Description_Optimize Multimedia CP: Reserves 10% of CPU time for background tasks instead of the Windows default of 20%, giving more headroom to games and multimedia. If your current value is already below 10, applying this will reduce priority.
Tweak_Description_Show Verbose Status Me: Shows detailed startup and shutdown status messages instead of the generic "Please wait..." screen.
Tweak_Description_Always Show All Tray I: Shows all notification area icons instead of hiding them behind the ^ arrow. (Windows 10 only)
Tweak_Description_Disable News and Inter: Removes the weather/news widget from the Windows 10 taskbar. (Windows 10 only)
Tweak_Description_Disable Widgets: Removes the Widgets button from the Windows 11 taskbar. (Windows 11 only)
Tweak_Description_Remove Meet Now Button: Hides the Meet Now (video call) button from the system tray. (Windows 10 only)
Tweak_Description_Hide Search Box: Collapses the taskbar search box to just an icon or hides it completely. 0=Hidden, 1=Icon, 2=Box.
Tweak_Description_Hide Task View Button: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.
Tweak_Description_Left-align Taskbar: Moves the taskbar icons back to the left side (Windows 11 centers them by default). (Windows 11 only)
Tweak_Description_Enable End Task on Tas: Adds an "End Task" option to the taskbar right-click menu for quick process termination. (Windows 11 only)
Tweak_Description_Use Small Taskbar Icon: Reduces taskbar icon size for a more compact taskbar. (Windows 10 only)
Tweak_Name_Disable Bing Search in Start: Disable Bing Search in Start Menu
Tweak_Description_Disable Bing Search in: Stops the Start menu from sending typed search queries to Bing/the web.
Tweak_Description_Enable Dark Theme: Enables the dark theme for both apps and the Windows system UI.
Tweak_Description_Enable Classic Context: Restores the full Windows 10-style right-click context menu in Windows 11. (Windows 11 only)
Tweak_Description_Disable Lock Screen: Skips the lock screen and goes directly to the sign-in screen on wake.
Tweak_Name_Show Most Used Apps in Start: Show Most Used Apps in Start Menu
Tweak_Description_Show Most Used Apps in: Controls the Most Used Apps list in the Start menu. 0=Hide, 1=Show, 2=Always show.
Tweak_Description_Disable Snap Assist Fl: Disables the snap layout flyout that appears when hovering over the maximize button.
Tweak_Name_Set Start Menu to More Pins L: Set Start Menu to More Pins Layout
Tweak_Description_Set Start Menu to More: Sets the Windows 11 Start menu to show more pinned apps and fewer recommendations.
Tweak_Description_Disable Transparency E: Turns off transparency and blur effects in the taskbar and windows.
